steps.label: App Connectivity Works

eyebrow: The same inventory skill, now proving it worked
code:
SELECT
    t.name AS table_name,
    SUM(p.rows) AS row_count
FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.partitions p
    ON t.object_id = p.object_id AND p.index_id IN (0, 1)
GROUP BY t.name
ORDER BY t.name;
